posts.title: The Degeneracy Economy
posts.blurb: 134 people paid $199 to join a program that throws them out if they do not ship in 30 days. The same psychology that runs the casino can be aimed at yourself.

posts.title: Your Brain Is Training Itself to Avoid Hard Things
posts.blurb: Procrastination is not laziness or bad time management. It is emotion regulation, and every time you avoid, you strengthen the circuit.

posts.title: Distribution Ate Everything
posts.blurb: OpenAI paid hundreds of millions for a podcast. Production costs are collapsing to zero, but nobody can print new eyeballs.
